lede: Nebraska carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.3 against +2.8, a 3.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Illinois +5.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Nebraska winning 64% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Illinois leads Nebraska by 91 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 75% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
